verdict.line: You're in real danger if Kled lands Bear Trap into his burst before level 6, but patient poke while his Q is down wins the lane, matching the 55.1% Gangplank win rate across 158 games.

brief.thesis: Kled's Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) reaches 800 units, 175 further than Parrrley's 625, and yanks you straight into his W (Violent Tendencies) attack-speed burst — so on paper he out-ranges you. That hook is locked behind an 11s cooldown at rank 1 falling to 7s at rank 5, while Parrrley resets every 5 seconds regardless of rank, so the entire lane is about refusing the 800-range window and flooding poke the moment his Q is down.

theirWindow.when: his Q (Bear Trap) is up, you're inside 800 range
theirWindow.what: He can hook, yank, and chain into W (Violent Tendencies)'s four-hit attack-speed burst plus an E (Jousting) follow-up dash. Stay outside 800 range or stand behind a minion wave so the trap catches a creep instead of you.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Bear Trap) just missed or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and fire Parrrley repeatedly — he has no hook to punish the approach for 7-11s. Stack Grog-Soaked Blade poison and step back out before his E (Jousting, 13-9s cooldown) comes back up.

start.why: The 56.8% win rate pick over 139 games — the extra sustain matters because every short trade window you take still eats a Kled auto, and you need to outlast him to level 6 without back-and-forth recalls.

boots.why: 59.2% win rate over 98 games; the flat auto-attack reduction directly blunts W (Violent Tendencies)'s four-hit attack-speed burst, which is the actual damage source behind his all-in, not his abilities.

core.why: Mana sustain is the whole plan — it lets you spam Parrrley on its full 5s cooldown all lane instead of running dry while waiting out Bear Trap
Converts stacked Grog-Soaked Blade poison ticks into executes once Kled dips below 5% HP, especially relevant against a dismounted Kled already fighting at reduced champion damage
61.1% win rate over 18 games on this path; shreds the armor Kled stacks to survive your poke once the lane turns in your favor

situational.when: you are ahead and want to close out skirmishes faster instead of grinding him down with poison

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards exactly the poke-and-back-off pattern this lane demands — it fires off Parrrley hits and stacks burn without requiring you to stand in his 800-range hook zone to apply it

summoners.why: The 53.7% win rate, 79.7% pick rate combo on this patch; Flash dodges the Bear Trap yank or the Jousting dash, and Ignite converts your poison poke lead into kills once Kled dismounts low.

playing.title: Respect the 800-range hook
playing.detail: Bear Trap on a Rope outranges Parrrley by 175 units and yanks you into his full combo. Don't walk inside 800 range unless his Q is visibly down or a minion wave is between you.

playing.title: Poke while his Q is down
playing.detail: The moment Bear Trap is on cooldown (7-11s depending on rank), close in and fire Parrrley on its flat 5s cooldown. He has nothing to punish the approach with until Q or Jousting comes back.

playing.title: Save W for the yank
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears crowd control and heals, but its cooldown is 22-18s. Hold it specifically to cleanse the Bear Trap shackle before the yank completes, not for minor chip damage.

playing.title: Fight him dismounted
playing.detail: Once Skaarl's health depletes, Kled deals less damage to champions and loses Bear Trap entirely, trading it for the weaker Pocket Pistol knockback. Force fights in this state, ideally right after his W burst is spent.

playing.title: Track his attack-speed window
playing.detail: Violent Tendencies grants a burst of attack speed for four hits with a heavier fourth swing. If his autos suddenly speed up, disengage until the fourth hit lands rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Zone his Charge with R
playing.detail: Cannon Barrage has unlimited range and lands damage over time with a slow. Drop it on the path of Chaaaaaaaarge!!! or on a retreating dismounted Kled instead of saving it purely for sieges.

playing.title: Build mana sustain first
playing.detail: Essence Reaver before damage items is what actually lets you spam Parrrley every 5 seconds all lane — that sustain, not raw stats, is the basis for out-poking a cooldown-starved Kled.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — range comparisons, cooldown windows, and the dismount/attack-speed timing calls — is tactical analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Kled’s (Q) while poking him often to gain the upper hand. If he dismounts Skaal, fight him after his (W) is on cooldown.
